The row's own rappel_detail[4].station already ends at Burgundy Col, while descent_text, rappel_detail[4].notes and baseFinding placed the landing at a 'first-pitch chimney near Action Potential's own start', which is 5-10 minutes away.

results.correct_value: The bench has a reliable spring a short walk north of camp (the creek beside camp is often dry); above it there is only an unreliable trickle below the col.
results.evidence: Posters on a water-at-the-bench thread call the little spring to the north of the bench easy to find and very reliable, with plenty running in mid-September. A 2019 trip report refilled at a spring in the sandy gully above the ~6,600 ft bench. Separately, a small trickle a little before the col is reported, but it is not dependable — so the bench is the last reliable water, not seasonal, and not the last water of any kind.
